🚩.remark: one per Bar, used often, the Turn continuing past it

🎏.remark: one reviewable chunk of the task closes, per [Movement and Suite](#movement-and-suite)

🤖.remark: eg AGENTS.md, AGENTS.local.md, CONTEXT.md, CONTEXT.local.md, skill and command definitions

~~.remark: eg a, b, ~~; use when ~ is ambiguous

arg.remark: value provided to function at call time; interchangeable w/ parameter casually

attribute.remark: variable owned by object; similar to field

🔨.remark: process files edits, eg compiler or bundler scripts, CI pipeline definitions

📝.remark: as only edits, eg comment bodies, banners, docstrings

🥁.remark: your own interrupted Turn resumes, or a 💤 wait has ended

h1.remark: one per file, naming the whole document

h3,h4,~.remark: at the depth the content actually reaches

🧸.remark: standalone usage examples/demos/toys, eg files under examples/

field.remark: variable declared inside an object, implies primitive data type; similar to attribute

🔒.remark: as only change, eg permission bits, executable bit

📂.remark: to a different directory, and filename may change as well; content unchanged besides minor edits

📛.remark: file renamed in place; content unchanged besides minor edits

function.remark: may include method, but implies standalone function

index.remark: queued changes: adding is "index", result is "indexed"; never "stage" or "cache"

hl.remark: skipping levels to label a sub-case read against its parent alone

member.remark: of object, include fields/attributes, properties, & methods

🙋.remark: a question or a clarification from the user

🧭.remark: what is planned, or likely, for the next Round

🔢.remark: file edits, eg binary, compressed archive, database, encrypted blob

📦.remark: edits of packaging or release metadata for current project, eg version field, lockfiles, package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml

parameter.remark: name in function, placeholder for value; interchangeable w/ argument casually

property.remark: field/attribute with accessor, like a getter or setter

♻️.remark: not change behavior, eg lines moved, symbols renamed, blocks extracted

regression.remark: unit test revision, part of TDD, finding bugs introduced by new implementation or refactoring, then Fixing Codebase so existing Unit Tests pass again

⚙️.remark: eg linter, formatter configuration, ignore files

SWD.remark: a 24-hour span, running 06:00 to 06:00 the next natural day; consecutive strict Watch Days tile without gap or overlap, so every instant belongs to exactly one

🏁.remark: nothing pending anywhere; rare, expect several 🚩/🎏 before one

🧪.remark: eg test suites, fixtures, snapshots, test helpers

h2.remark: marking a primary section directly under the Title

🔖.remark: edits of tag itself or line it annotates, regardless of if in code or documentation

utility or maintenance scripts edits.remark: not part of main codebase, eg files under scripts/

💤.remark: anything outside your own Turn: a long-running process, an API request, a dispatched subagent, a separate workflow, another party

WD.remark: a 30-hour span, running 00:00 to 06:00 the next natural day; consecutive Watch Days overlap across 00:00~06:00, so a task logged at 03:00 belongs to both this Watch Day and the one before it

WWk.remark: forward range from today through the close of a terminal Sunday

📏.remark: as only edits: indentation, tabs, blank lines added or removed

wt.remark: main worktree unless a linked one is named
